issues.failure_explanation: The prose promises a positive answer to the set-membership question "does it follow that all $x_k$ belongs to $\Lambda_h$?". Theorem thm:pos_invariance proves instead that all iterates stay in the fixed sublevel set $V^{-1}([0,\varepsilon])$. Since $\Lambda_h$ is a thin set with $\Lambda_h\to\Lambda$ as $h\to0^+$ while $V^{-1}([0,\varepsilon])$ is a full neighborhood of $\Lambda$ of fixed radius, membership in $V^{-1}([0,\varepsilon])$ does not imply membership in $\Lambda_h$; no result of the paper establishes $x_k\in\Lambda_h$ for all $k$.
